  Number Theory and Cryptography [CSE-3111]  
  Marks: 50                                                                                Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)           Given the number N=220×315×57, find its prime factorization. Include a step-by-step  
  explanation of the algorithm you use.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Find GCD of 1070 and 1066 using the Euclid algorithm. Prove that every positive  
  integer greater than 1 has a unique prime factorization                                   (5)  
  
  2)           For each of the following equations, find an integer x that satisfies the equation.  
  $$a. 4 x= 2 (mod 3 )$$  
  $$b. 7x = 4 (mod 9 )                                                                        (5)$$  
  $$A)      c. 5x = 3 (mod 11)$$  
  
  B)      Given 5 as a primitive root of 23, solve the following congruences.  
  $$a. 3x5 =2 (mod 23)$$  
  $$b. 7x10+1=0 (mod 23)                                                                      (5)$$  
  $$c. 5x=6 (mod 23)$$  
  
  3)           Prove that triplet {Zn, +n, *n} for non-prime n is a commutative ring  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Show that the inverse of 5 mod 101 is 599Compute 240262mod 14 using modular  
  exponentiation.                                                                           (5)  
  
  4)           Apply Caesar cipher with k=5 & decrypt the given Cipher text  
  "YMJTYMJWXNIJTKXNQJSHJ". For the obtained plain text apply Vigenere cipher  
  (5)  
  using the key "leg". Compare the efficiency of both.  
  A)  
  B)      In a communication channel Alice and Bob agreed to use Hill cipher cryptosystem in  
  which Alice transmits a message "BDSJ" & Bob receives "GAHR" at his end. Compute (5)  
  the key they have agreed upon for communication.  
  
  5)           Justify Why Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) has replaced DES, 2DES and TDES. (5)
